items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: interfering with where Smoke was playing on the drum

ctx.x: So I don't think he used the pedal at all. I don't think he used the pedal.
No, no. He kicked. And so what he was doing there was interfering with where Smoke was playing on the drum. So the man put a pedal down there, you know. But it all come out good, though.
